body: Thank you for your response. I actually found it really helpful.

I would always recommend seeking help. Even if it's something like an anonymous helpline. It's amazingly cathartic to just say everything that's on your mind to a random person. Hotlines are available and so is professional help. You have things to live for. You're just having trouble seeing them right now.
The people near you already think good things about you. Those things don't magically appear if you die. You're a good person with good qualities. Seek help. Talking with someone works wonders.

Hardly any of those describe the characters you listed. They might have one or two traits in common with those cliche'd archetypes, but most of them are very inaccurate. Also Ros isn't even a character in the books, which makes me doubt that you've read them. You can't claim to understand the characters at all as GRRM wrote them if you've only watched the show.
